summary.headline: Weekly center migrated lower to 7680-7700: defensive front-end versus a new Friday 7680 long-volatility center
key_points: Monday fresh flow is front-loaded: about 54.7% of visible premium is Tuesday, 18.2% Wednesday and 27.1% Friday.
Tuesday is package-dependent defensive: the 7700 synthetic-short-like package contributes about -$308m signed transaction delta, while 7680-7685 contains heavy put-risk acceptance.
Friday-baseline 7750 protection is not reinforced and is a partial monetization/unwind candidate; 7715 call-supply also loses relevance.
Wednesday shifts from the Friday sold-range/long-vol conflict toward defined-risk downside acceptance around 7690-7725, but opposite spread flow shows churn.
Friday keeps end-week convexity demand alive through repeated matched 7680 call+put buys totaling 372x per side in the clearest linked series.
Thursday remains unformed with no visible $50k+ prints.
summary.daily_note: Stateful update versus the 2026-08-28 Friday baseline. Active weekly battlefield is 7680-7700; above 7700 route reopens 7715-7725 then 7750, while failure below 7675 activates 7655-7660 and then 7625-7615.

leave_one_out.comment: Largest single print is 234x 7725P sell in Wednesday; removing it does not by itself overturn the mixed/defensive weekly read.

leave_largest_package_out.comment: Largest timestamp package is the Friday 7615C/7625C vertical-like package; removing it does not erase the 7680 volatility center.

structures.interpretation: Ten timestamp packages contain equal-size 7680C and 7680P buys, totaling 372x per side and about $2.86m gross. This is the clearest new end-week volatility center.
Same-time 80x 7615C buy / 7625C sell is a call-debit-like package. Deep ITM moneyness makes it more likely to be inventory/roll mechanics than a clean upside target signal.

100x 7700C buy / 7700P sell is synthetic-long-like, but Friday contained multiple 100x 7700P buys. The put sale therefore has a strong reverse-size match and is treated as a partial unwind/restructure candidate rather than clean fresh bullish exposure.
Same-time equal-size 7695P sell / 7675P buy is consistent with a defined-risk put-credit-like package around the new working center.

caveats: BUY/SELL and signed transaction delta do not prove fresh opening exposure.
Complex-order IDs are absent, so linked packages are inferred from timestamp, size, strike geometry and execution context.
Repeated identical-parameter prints with unique trade IDs are retained as separate fills; some may be fragmented executions of one parent order.

The export timezone column says America/New_York, while clock times extend to about 23:07 and align with Cyprus-local SPX hours; raw clock-time semantics are therefore treated as exporter-ambiguous and structure timestamps are normalized to the user snapshot timezone for this report.
Thursday has no visible $50k+ prints; this means the visible book is unformed, not that market positioning is zero.
Friday baseline is used for stateful comparison, but without next-day OI a reverse-side match remains an unwind/roll hypothesis rather than confirmed closing.
